# Team roles and responsibilities

This guide describes responsibilities that the team can assign or combine. It
does not identify who held a role or imply that a formal Scrum process was
followed. Add names only after the team confirms its actual assignments.

## Product direction

The person acting as product owner or project representative:

- explains the user need and intended outcome;
- helps order work by importance and constraints;
- clarifies acceptance criteria and resolves scope questions; and
- reviews whether a demonstrated change meets the agreed need.

## Scrum Master / team facilitator

The person facilitating the team's process:

- helps the team make work, decisions, and blockers visible;
- facilitates planning, check-ins, reviews, or retrospectives when the team
  actually schedules them;
- records decisions and follow-up actions accurately;
- helps surface impediments and coordinate an owner or escalation; and
- encourages a sustainable process without claiming ceremonies happened when
  they did not.

The facilitator supports the team; the role does not mean unilaterally assigning
work or guaranteeing delivery.

## Developers

People implementing the application:

- clarify the change and its acceptance criteria before implementation;
- make focused changes and explain relevant technical or security impacts;
- run appropriate checks and report the actual results;
- keep secrets and real user data out of source control; and
- respond to review feedback and update documentation when needed.

## Tester / reviewer

The person testing or reviewing a change:

- checks behavior against the acceptance criteria and relevant role permissions;
- records environment, steps, result, and evidence without exposing sensitive
  information;
- distinguishes a test plan or source inspection from a test that was actually
  executed; and
- reports defects with enough detail to reproduce them.

In a small team, people may share responsibilities. Agree on who is doing what
for a particular change rather than assuming a role title guarantees a task was
completed.

## Confirming assignments

| Responsibility | Team member(s) | Confirmed? |
|---|---|---|
| Product direction / acceptance decisions | _Team to complete_ | _No_ |
| Scrum facilitation / impediments | _Team to complete_ | _No_ |
| Development | _Team to complete_ | _No_ |
| Testing / review | _Team to complete_ | _No_ |
